description: This page provides an explanation of the legislation Will Campbell will submit to the floor for a vote on day 1 to provide immediate aid to the people of Sand Branch, TX to build their long term water and sewage infrastructure.
paid_for_by: authorized by general law to provide water, wastewater, drainage, flood-control, or related utility service in the area of the Sand Branch community
title: Relief for Sand Branch, TX - A Bill to Build Their Water and Wastewater Needs — Will Campbell For Texas
